events.themeBlurb: वचन अध्ययन शिविर 2026: परमेश्वर के वचन को सही रीति से समझना, जीवन में लागू करना और विश्वासयोग्यता से सिखाना। 26 से 29 अक्टूबर 2026, ईशोपंथी आश्रम, पूरी, ओडिशा।

events.organiserBlurb: Dedicated to encouraging biblically grounded study, expository preaching, and equipping church leaders across India under Satya Vachan Church.
events.description: वचन अध्ययन शिविर 2026 पूरी, ओडिशा एक 4-दिवसीय गहन बाइबल अध्ययन एवं प्रचार प्रशिक्षण सम्मेलन है। शिविर का मुख्य उद्देश्य परमेश्वर के वचन को सही रीति से समझना, जीवन में लागू करना और विश्वासयोग्यता से सिखाना है।

faqs.question: Who can register for this conference?
faqs.answer: Registration is open only to Indian christians. Participants from other countries are not eligible to register for this conference.

faqs.question: Why should anyone attend this conference?
faqs.answer: The All India Pastors' Conference is a great opportunity for pastors and men aspiring to ministry to enjoy singing together, sit under faithful preaching by Indian pastors, fellowship with brothers from churches across the country, receive helpful resources for ministry, and encourage one another.

faqs.question: What is unique about this conference?
faqs.answer: The All India Pastors' Conference is a collaborative indigenous initiative, led by Indian pastors of evangelical churches from different parts of India who belong to the Reformed tradition.

faqs.question: How many times has this conference been held before?
faqs.answer: So far, the conference has happened 7 times (Once in Lucknow, twice in Hyderabad, twice online, and twice in Mumbai). This year's conference will be the 8th All India Pastors' Conference.

faqs.question: When will AIPC 2026 take place?
faqs.answer: The dates for this year's conference are 29 September to 01 October, 2026. Check-in starts at 12:00 noon on the 29th. The conference will end after lunch on the 01 October (3:00 pm).

faqs.question: Where will AIPC 2026 take place?
faqs.answer: AIPC 2026 will take place in GCC Hotel and Club, Mira Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faqs.question: How can I reach GCC Hotel and Club?
faqs.answer: See the Travel page for station-by-station directions, or open the venue location in Google Maps.

faqs.question: How important is it for participants to be versed in English?
faqs.answer: All the sessions and panel discussions and resources will be in English, and so this conference is only for men who can communicate in English.

faqs.question: What are the options for accommodation?
faqs.answer: There are 3 options for accommodation. In Quadruple Sharing, each room will be shared by 4 participants. In Triple Sharing, each room will be shared by 3 participants. In Double Sharing, each room will be shared by 2 participants.

faqs.question: How early can participants check-in on 29 September?
faqs.answer: The check-in time starts at 12:00 noon on 29 September.
